note: City of Rock Valley campground on 94 acres of former sand and gravel quarry, around three ponds beside the Rock River. Sand beach on its own swimming pond; the two fishing ponds allow non-motorized boats. --Claude
summary: Operator's own site found: 74 full-hookup back-in sites (was 19 FHU + 55 electric), $27 added, online booking (was phone), May 1-Oct 15, 14-night limit; pond holds.
flags: WATERFRONT: pond holds. The operator calls all three ponds (Cabin Cove, Rock n' Reel, The Swimming Hole) ponds. Imagery scales them at about 5 ha, 4 ha and 2 ha. Odd sites 1-19 back toward Cabin Cove Pond with about 25-30 m of open mown grass and no road between. The Road #3 rows (48-67) lie between two ponds with about 15-20 m of grass, but a faint mown track runs along the shore and only 48-51 of those are nightly (52-61 monthly, 62-67 seasonal). East-side Road 2 sites face the swim pond, which is day use.
WEBSITE (apply.py doesn't write it): the stored city page is one sentence. The operator's site is https://campatriversbend.com/site/.
PHONE (apply.py doesn't write it): the operator's contact page gives 712-476-6065 May-October and 712-476-5707 November-April. Only the second is stored.

LONG-STAY SHARE: 19 of 74 sites are monthly or seasonal by the operator's map, $3,100 a season, with unreserved seasonal sites released May 1. The map also marks 73-74 as patrol sites. It's a city campground and the rest are nightly; reported only.
VEHICLE PASS: rates list $5 a day or $25/$35 a year without saying who pays it. If it applies to campers, the night is $32, still well inside the gate; fee base left at $27.

UNREAD: reservationfriend's calendar loads but I did not quote a night or read its booking window; window left unset. The city page also links a different engine, rockvalley.activityreg.com, whose page returned no campground text. The stored rating is RV Life's; not re-read.
PIN: 43.2130,-96.3095 is on Road 2 in the middle of the site block; good.

LEAD: the same city runs BiCentennial Park Campground, 1800 11th Street, Rock Valley: 6 reservation-only sites, $20, 30/50 amp (https://www.cityofrockvalley.com/our-community/campgrounds). I did not vet it or check whether the database holds it.
